stemMd: Why might multiple descriptive terms per file help?

options.label: A
options.textMd: They make every file contain more original research.

options.label: B
options.textMd: They guarantee that every possible query will succeed.

options.label: C
options.textMd: They require users never to change their vocabulary.

options.label: D
options.textMd: They can match different words users employ for the same subject.

options.label: E
options.textMd: They remove the need to store documents.

explanationMd: If users search using different but related terms, additional descriptors can connect their queries to the same file. This bridges language variation without requiring identical wording from all teams.

distractorRationale.a: Adding metadata does not create new research content.
distractorRationale.b: The passage describes improvement, not a universal guarantee.
distractorRationale.e: Descriptions support access to stored records.
distractorRationale.c: The aim is to connect varied language.
